purpose: Verify whether the proposed single-symbol continuity witness is actually bound to the exact PIT replay window consumed by SHORT_MOMENTUM, and prevent RAW price history from being mislabeled as adjusted technical continuity.

evidence: buildPitReplayWindow preserves each selected bar continuityState in replayWindow.bars, but A1 history factor eligibility is not derived by checking every bar continuityState.
buildA1HistoryPrimitiveBundle gates continuity-sensitive factors from one top-level continuityState argument.
continuity-sensitive factors are TECH.TREND, TECH.STRUCTURE, PV.ACCEPTANCE, PV.RESPONSE and RISK.EXTENSION.
PV.RELATIVE_VOLUME and RISK.LIQUIDITY do not require the continuity flag.
Therefore immutable prior D1 rows may remain UNVERIFIED if an external exact-window certifier truthfully certifies the entire selected window.
runDailyLimitedShadowOrchestratorV0_1 calls resolveContinuityState before loading prior history and before buildPitReplayWindow.
The current resolver interface returns only a text state such as CLEAR_NO_ACTION.
The current bar is constructed using that text state before replay-window selection.
The resolver cannot inspect or verify the actual selected PIT revisions/session set because replayWindow does not yet exist.
buildA1HistoryPrimitiveBundle sourcePayloadHash hashes normalized date/OHLC/volume/tradeValue content only; normalizeBar strips continuity receipt identity and source-row lineage.
The factor bundle stores the top-level continuityState but not continuityReceiptId/sourceHistoryHash/continuityTransformHash.
Candidate sourceManifest currently binds current A1 sourceRowHash/batchHash but does not bind a continuity receipt.
Therefore a valid witness for one historical window could be accidentally reused after selected-window/revision drift unless a post-replay identity check is added.
buildA1HistoryPrimitiveBundle treats both CLEAR_NO_ACTION and ADJUSTED_CONTINUITY as continuityEligible.
The daily orchestrator currently loads RAW prior bars and constructs a RAW current bar.
No technical-continuity price transform is applied before coreMetrics are computed.
Thus merely labeling the top-level state ADJUSTED_CONTINUITY would make continuity-sensitive factors KNOWN while still computing from RAW history.

sharedD03ContractFit.reusableWindowPattern: D03 Bollinger V0.2 hashes the continuity receipt identity plus ordered exact bars/source identities into continuityWindowHash and verifies date-set equality, unresolvedMissingSessions=0, unresolvedRelevantEvents=0 and no pseudo bars.
sharedD03ContractFit.adaptation: SHORT_MOMENTUM needs its own exact 61-session window rather than D03 Bollinger's 20-session window, but the provenance and hash-binding semantics should stay shared.

proposedSequence: Fetch current official A1 and load exact prior PIT rows without mutating D1.
Build the raw PIT replay window first using an unpromoted current-bar continuity marker.
Compute an exact raw-window identity from the selected replay rows using ordered marketDate + sourceId + sourceRowHash + availableAt + OHLCV identity fields, excluding the later continuity label.
Resolve/validate a versioned continuity receipt only after the replay window exists.
Require continuity receipt symbol/asOf/decision cutoff/session date-set/sourceHistoryHash to match the actual selected replay window.
For first NC-T01, accept only a receipt disposition that proves CLEAR_NO_ACTION over the exact 61-session window.
Pass CLEAR_NO_ACTION into buildA1HistoryPrimitiveBundle only after the identity match succeeds.

Bind continuityReceiptId + receiptHash + sourceHistoryHash + continuityTransformHash into factor-bundle provenance and/or candidate sourceManifest so the resulting factor/decision evidence retains the witness lineage.
Any mismatch returns UNVERIFIED / INCOMPLETE; never silently reuse a stale witness.

interfaceDirection.preferred: Add a versioned post-replay resolveContinuityEvidence/validateContinuityReceipt seam rather than making the current pre-replay string resolver authoritative for physical NC-T01.
interfaceDirection.backwardCompatibility: Existing fixture-level resolveContinuityState may remain for isolated tests, but the physical NC-T01 workflow must require the hash-bound evidence path.

requiredNegativeTests: valid witness but one historical sourceRowHash changes -> reject
valid witness but one selected market date changes -> reject
valid witness captured after decision cutoff -> reject
valid witness for different symbol -> reject
valid witness for different asOf date -> reject
minimalRuntimeDelta.requiredPositiveTest: One TWSE history-ready symbol with an exact 61-session CLEAR_NO_ACTION receipt whose ordered date/source-history identity exactly matches the live PIT replay window becomes continuityEligible; all other uncertified symbols remain INCOMPLETE and denominator-accounted.

ncT01Consequence.priorAuditSupersession: The earlier TWSE single-witness certifier audit remains directionally valid but is incomplete if implemented as a string-only resolver. This audit adds the mandatory exact replay-window hash binding.

protectedBoundaries: No provider-adjusted series relabeled as TECHNICAL_CONTINUITY
